maya: Heads-up — a customer hit double token charges when a streaming session reconnected while a toolcall TTL expired. Noticed around 03:12 UTC, small sample attached.

ben: Can you paste the minimal trace and the billing IDs?

maya: sure, truncated logs: ```
I 03:11:58 router: session=abc123 assigned->node7
I 03:12:05 router: session=abc123 start-toolcall id=tc-9 ttl=5s
I 03:12:09 node7: emitted 120 tokens stream-prefix="Hello"
W 03:12:11 heartbeat lost, reconnecting
I 03:12:12 router: session=abc123 reassigned->node3
I 03:12:15 router: toolcall-evict id=tc-9 expired
I 03:12:17 node3: resume-stream session=abc123 new-stream-id=s2 emitted 85 tokens
Billing: provisional_credit session=abc123 120 tokens; final_charge session=abc123 205 tokens
```

olga: Looks like the prefix from the first stream was credited as provisional, then the resumed stream and the toolcall finalization both got charged. Router reassign + toolcall TTL ordering.

ben: Are those provisional credits surfaced in the console? I thought provisional credits are internal only.

maya: Right now provisional shows in an internal ledger, not the UI. Customer saw final invoice only, so they couldn't reconcile.

infra-bot: Deploybot: rollout v3.2.4 to router-prod completed (shard a-c) :white_check_mark:

sam: Hypothesis: heartbeat retry window > toolcall TTL. The resume handshake doesn't include the original toolcall id, so ledger can't tie resumed tokens to the in-flight toolcall and ends up creating a second charge. Quick fix: include toolcall_id in resume_token and treat resume emissions as continuations if toolcall still exists.

olga: Also +1 for adding a metric: "stream_resume_toolcall_mismatch" with labels {routing_policy, resume_reason}. Able to alert if >1% of resumed sessions in a 5m window.

maya: Immediate mitigation idea: mark credits as "tentative" in the ledger and in Console show them as dashed-line provisional until toolcall final ack. That way customers see a reconciliation row instead of surprise final charge. Question: business ok with exposing provisional numbers?

ben: Telemetry changes we need: tag both emit events and toolcall lifecycle events with routing_policy, toolcall_id, session_id, resume_id. Add a sample trace link to the billing row. I'll open a PR to add the tags to the emit path.

olga: UX note — don't spam console with tiny provisional entries. Suggest threshold: only surface provisional credits for >100 tokens or >$1. Otherwise keep them internal but include in CSV exports for audits.

maya: I'll draft an RFC with the resume-handshake patch + ledger heuristics + console toggles. Opening ticket: <https://redwood.atlassian/browse/PI-999>. Will include a sample patch: ```
# resume handler snippet (pseudo)
if resume.handshake.toolcall_id and ledger.exists(toolcall_id):
  mark_emissions_as_continuation(toolcall_id)
else:
  mark_emissions_as_new_charge()
```

sam: Nice. For immediate debugging let's add a Kibana panel for "resume vs toolcall overlap" and a short runbook: how to issue a provisional refund if customer complains.

maya: Agreed. I'll spin up a quick dashboard with the new metric and tag filters. Will post follow-up when RFC + PRs are ready. :thumbsup:
